+
+Dependency-free Python 3.11+ HTTP service with atomic JSON-file persistence.
+
+```sh
+python3 server.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 --data ./data.json

+

+
+- `PUT /v1/kv/{url-encoded-key}`: JSON `{"value": any, "ttl_seconds": positive-number?}`
+- `GET /v1/kv/{url-encoded-key}`
+- `DELETE /v1/kv/{url-encoded-key}`
+- `GET /v1/keys`
+- `GET /health`
+
+Example:
+
+```sh
+curl -X PUT localhost:8080/v1/kv/hello%20world -d '{"value":{"ok":true}}'
+curl localhost:8080/v1/kv/hello%20world
+```
+
+All normal responses and errors are JSON except the empty `204` deletion response. Entries with TTLs are removed when accessed or listed and are never restored after expiry.
